launch_authorization.scope: lvl30/raw/lvl23 blocks + eval_metrics (CLAP b1, AES, level, FAD raw) + MEva + MIR for the 113 external baselines, the MusicCaps real reference, and the 114 MeanAudio cells if present; no generation, no training.

question: Objective columns of the paper TTM comparison table (ttm_quality_comparison_plan_20261007.md tables B/D) on one loudness protocol.

fixed_protocol.silent_rule: raw RMS < -45 dBFS or integrated LUFS < -70 / not finite: not gained, kept as raw, counted as failure (plan §7.7)
fixed_protocol.peak_rule: gain reduced so peak = 0.999 (level_match_rescore rule, no limiter); per-system count; lvl30 rate > 1% => processing_unequal
fixed_protocol.format: gained audio FLAC PCM_24 (scorers read {id}.flac; deviation D1)
fixed_protocol.fad_mir_blocks: FAD and MIR on raw only (deviation D2)

deviations.D1: plan §7.7 says float32 WAV; every scorer globs {id}.flac and FLAC has no float, so PCM_24 (noise floor ~-144 dBFS; PCM_16 starts to move PQ only below -42 dB, 065).
deviations.D2: FAD only on raw: the reference set is raw real audio and VGGish embeddings are level-dependent, so lvl30 FAD would partly measure the level offset; raw FAD is also what the literature reports. MIR (beats/chroma) is level-free, raw only.
deviations.D3: MeanAudio 114 cells (CFG0, CFG3+neg) are scored only if both REPORTs exist at the first run; frozen in selection.json. If 114 failed, rerun 115 later with the same contract after 114 is fixed (selection.json must be deleted first).
deviations.D4: MusicCaps real reference: 5,131 of 5,521 ids exist; scored with --allow_missing as an anchor, no FAD (it is the FAD reference), excluded from the silent union.

markers.section: MEva on musicgen_medium is descriptive only (MEva backbone = MusicGen-small)
markers.double_dagger: AES cross-sampling-rate comparisons (16 kHz MusicLDM/MeanAudio vs 32 kHz MusicGen) are descriptive only (16k bias, PAM audit)
markers.dagger: not applicable to the 114 slot0clean row (no PQ-directed training component); the CFG3+neg cell uses fidelity8 chosen on MusicCaps AES PQ

resume.note: step-level restart: a gain block, metrics, MEva or MIR output that validates is skipped; a partial one is redone whole

completion_evidence.method: guest writes terminal with sha256 of the registered summary after --validate-only passes
